**How to submit:** Write your answers in a document or on paper. Upload the file or a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 27**.

A student studio will sell *Paper Kites*, a small game. These are five of
its assets:

| asset | what the team found |
|---|---|
| wind_loop.ogg | "Wind Loop" by Dana Saleh, sounds.example.org/wind-loop, CC BY 4.0, no credit yet |
| kite_red.png | drawn by a team member |
| clouds.png | from an image search, page unknown |
| title_font.ttf | "Kite Hand" by Lettera Studio, SIL OFL 1.1, no credit yet |
| bird.png | art site, CC BY-NC 4.0 |

## Task 1 · The audit (3 marks)

a) Give each asset a status: cleared, to fix or replace. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=5 >}}

b) For each asset that is not cleared, write the fix. (1 mark)
